title: AI Daily Inbox Briefing
businessOutcomes: You start the day knowing what actually needs attention.
summary: Start each day with a prioritized summary of urgent emails, pending replies, and calendar conflicts — without reading every message.
businessProblem: Owners and operators spend the first 30–60 minutes of each day scanning inboxes reactively, often missing urgent client messages buried under newsletters and internal noise.
outcome: A concise morning briefing delivered by 7 AM listing: emails needing reply today, messages waiting 48+ hours, and today's meetings with one-line context from related threads.
expectedOutcomes: A concise morning briefing delivered by 7 AM listing: emails needing reply today, messages waiting 48+ hours, and today's meetings with one-line context from related threads.
whoItsFor: Solo business owners, agency principals, and office managers who manage their own inbox and calendar without an executive assistant.
aiInputs: Unread and recent email threads (subject, sender, body, age)
Custom priority rules (e.g., emails from VIP clients, invoices, booking confirmations)
aiOutputs: Prioritized email action list with suggested reply urgency
One-line context per calendar event from related email threads
Draft replies for top 3 urgent messages (optional)
noCodeTools: Zapier or Make.com for scheduled trigger
ChatGPT with Gmail/Calendar plugins (manual daily run)
Google Apps Script + OpenAI API (lightweight custom)
lowCodeTools: n8n workflow with Gmail + Calendar + OpenAI nodes
Relevance AI agent with Gmail connector
implementationSteps: Connect Gmail and Google Calendar via OAuth with read scopes
Define priority rules: which senders, keywords, or labels escalate urgency
Build prompt template: inbox threads + calendar → structured briefing format
Schedule daily run at 6:30 AM local time
Deliver briefing via email draft, Slack message, or mobile notification
Review first 2 weeks of briefings and tune priority rules based on misses
systemBehavior: Runs on a fixed daily schedule (not real-time)
Reads inbox state at run time — does not monitor continuously
Never sends emails automatically without explicit opt-in to that feature
Skips newsletters, automated notifications, and marketing unless flagged
Preserves thread context — summarizes, does not replace reading critical emails
risks: AI may deprioritize genuinely urgent messages with unusual phrasing
OAuth tokens expire — unattended runs fail silently without monitoring
Briefing sent to wrong channel could expose client email content
Over-reliance reduces owner's direct inbox awareness over time

faq.question: Which AI tools can I use?
faq.answer: The Manual includes versions for ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. Available Gmail and Calendar capabilities may differ by platform and plan.

faq.question: Does the workflow send emails automatically?
faq.answer: No. The initial workflow is designed for reviewing, organizing, and drafting only.

faq.question: Can I use a work Google account?
faq.answer: Possibly, but your organization may restrict external AI connections. Confirm your company's policies and administrator settings first.

faq.question: Do I need technical experience?
faq.answer: No coding is required for the Manual version. The guide explains the setup and includes ready-to-use prompts and templates.

faq.question: What is the difference between Manual, Local, and App?
faq.answer: Manual teaches you how to build and customize the workflow. Local makes repeated use easier on your computer. The App is planned as a managed, scheduled service.

faq.question: Are AI subscription or API fees included?
faq.answer: No. Any ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or API charges are separate unless explicitly stated.
